id.description: Stable slug. Lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens. Never changes once published, because URLs and cross-references use it.

date.description: ISO 8601 at the precision known: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Always a quoted string in YAML. Never padded with invented months or days.

end_date.description: End of a period: a date, or "present" for ongoing.

doi.description: Bare DOI without resolver prefix, e.g. 10.1037/met0000672.

path.description: Path relative to the repo root. For files served on the site, the path is also the URL path.

tags.description: Finer topic tags. Lowercase, hyphenated, one spelling per concept.

markdown.description: Inline Markdown subset only: *italic*, **bold**, `code`, [links](https://...). Rendered by both Typst (cmarker) and Astro.

given.description: Given names as far as known, full or initials. Never expanded from initials by guessing.

link.description: A URL, or a URL with a short note (e.g. "synthetic data").

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, BE, US. Templates render the name.

hidden.description: Kept in the data, but no template shows it by default. Used for content that was commented out in the legacy CV.

note.description: Free-text note for me. Never rendered.
